Temperature set for ~200 mm/s on this printer: 225 C (first layer 210 C). Manufacturer bands: 205-215 C at 50-100 mm/s; 215-235 C at 100-200 mm/s. Printing much faster or slower than this printer's default process? Adjust the nozzle temperature along those bands.
Product page: 205-215C @50-100, 215-235C @100-200mm/s. Shore (HA/HD) 80. Wiki lists 210-230C. Wiki: fan ON, drying 50C.
